name: Pending Reason 37 Code
definition: Specifies the reason the transaction/instruction is pending or failing settlement. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is still possible, status is pending. Settlement on the instructed settlement date is no longer possible, status is failing.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Instruction was received after the account servicer's deadline. It will be managed as per the bilateral service agreement between the account servicer and account owner.

WCTF.name: Awaiting Counterparty Response
WCTF.definition: Allegement has been sent out to counterparty. Waiting for their response.

BSTR.name: Before Instruction Period
BSTR.definition: Instruction is submitted before instruction start date.

BUMM.name: Buyer Protection Mismatch
BUMM.definition: Counterparty disagreement on the chosen corporate action outturn.

DQCS.name: Disagreement On Cash Amount
DQCS.definition: Unrecognised or invalid instructed cash amount.

ECRD.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline Missed
ECRD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty response deadline.

NTAX.name: Inconsistent Tax Rate
NTAX.definition: Tax rate is not consistent with the documentation in place.

ITAX.name: Incorrect Tax Rate
ITAX.definition: Tax rate provided is incorrect. It falls outside the acceptable values for that investment country.

IPED.name: Instruction Prior To Entitlement Date
IPED.definition: Instruction was received prior to entitlement date.

IPAW.name: Invalid Paperwork
IPAW.definition: Required paperwork is invalid, incomplete or missing.

LACK.name: Lack Of Securities
LACK.definition: Insufficient financial instruments in your account.

LATE.name: Market Deadline Missed
LATE.definition: Instruction was received after market deadline.

FULL.name: Pending Beneficiary Owner Details
FULL.definition: Pending receipt of beneficiary owner details.

PENR.name: Pending Receipt
PENR.definition: Instruction is pending receipt of securities, for example, from a purchase or loan.

DQUA.name: Quantity Disagreement
DQUA.definition: Quantity of financial instruments does not match.

SNAV.name: System Not Available
SNAV.definition: System is not available. Instruction is sent outside of business hours.
